sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-2B is a 2-billion parameter causal language model with integrated vision encoding capabilities, developed by unsloth. The model implements a hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks with sparse Mixture-of-Experts to achieve high-throughput inference with minimal latency. sources.title: Qwen 3.5 Small Models: Multimodal AI on Your Laptop and Phone, Offline
sources.snippet: Alibaba's Qwen 3.5 small model series challenges a long-standing assumption in AI development: that sophisticated multimodal capabilities require enormous parameter counts.
